blocks.text: Tags allow admins to manage the data that is assigned to resource groups with custom criteria. Admins can manually edit custom tags at any time.
Enable policy enforcement for your organization. To learn more, see Enabling Microsegmentation Policy Settings.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Tag Management.
Select the namespace that contains the tag you want to edit.
Click the Edit icon on the chosen tag.
Key: Edit the key name for the custom tag.
Description: (Optional) Add or remove information that describes the tag.

Values: Add or remove individual values, separated by commas, for the tag. To add many values to the tag, click the Add button next to the Values field, and it displays a table of all the added values. You can also delete any added values by clicking the Delete icon.

blocks.text: The page reloads and the changes to your custom tag appear in the list.
